checks.command: PYTHONPATH=scripts/people python3 -m unittest scripts.people.test_normal_flow scripts.people.test_crossing_gate scripts.people.test_episode_phases scripts.people.test_episode_clock

reviewFindings: No blocker found for a controlled live trial.
Accepted-crossing exit repair requires the original accepted program, program counter, named crossing and exact target; it only plans a same-endcap path to that original exit.
A curb entry reapproach must stay outside all crosswalks and road geometry, then recheck the unchanged full native path, WALK, shared phase coherence and cohort gate.
Returned native path includes actual start and requested target connectors for both geometry and length checks.
Alignment rejects invalid native IDs before polling and requires observed endpoint proximity; native raw failures and timeouts remain diagnostic evidence.
Program advance, rollback, public reload, agent rearm and owned-program restore retire repair permission.
Entry repair does not grant a new crossing admission or restore a prior native task ID.
limits: Native paths are planned navigation geometry, not observed avoidance trajectories.
Native-agent CPU objects are mocks; this review does not qualify live arrival, throughput, camera counts or cross-camera fusion.
Existing-road exit clearance is scoped by accepted-crossing provenance, same-endcap path, crossing exclusions and safe target; no new absolute path-length threshold was added.
No source controller, runtime, Kit, model, camera, renderer or signal changes were made by reviewer.
